results.title: “Courage for Surgical Strikes, But Not Talks?” Mani Shankar Aiyar Questions India’s Pakistan Policy
results.description: Congress veteran Mani Shankar Aiyar urged India to resume dialogue with Pakistan, suggesting talks at Wagah-Attari and arguing that unresolved issues should be addressed through sustained diplomacy.

results.title: Christa Pike Execution: Tennessee Prison Chief Resigns After Botched Lethal Injection
results.description: Frank Strada, the prison chief of Tennessee, has stepped down from his post. He resigned after a massive goof-up during the execution of Christa Pike, the only woman on death row in the state. The lethal injection process failed, and she ended up unconscious on a hospital ventilator.
